svg.title: Model-based PI tuning of the heater
svg.desc: With gains calculated for a 5 second response, the heater program reaches 63.2 percent of a 3 degree setpoint change after 6.1 seconds without overshoot. Control Studio's SIMC design, with lower gains, reaches it after 7.8 seconds. Under a 30 kilowatt load, the 5 second design holds the temperature above 33.66 degrees, the SIMC design above 33.53 degrees.
svg.text: Model-based PI gains on the actual heater program
Control Studio validation runs · λ = 5 s design (Kp 4.17, Ki 0.833) and Control Studio's SIMC design (Kp 3.21, Ki 0.655) · numbers answer the predictions
Single lag λ = 5 s after the 1 s delay
63.2 % at 6.1 s, as L + λ = 6 s predicts
30 kW load: lowest 33.66 °C with λ = 5 s, 33.53 °C with SIMC
